Added `spec.consistentHash` support to `TrafficPolicy` and committed all changes on branch `feat/consistent-hash`:

### Summary of Changes
1. **API & CRD Types** ([traffic_policy_types.go](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-9dx3n06x/api/v1alpha1/kgateway/traffic_policy_types.go), [zz_generated.deepcopy.go](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-9dx3n06x/api/v1alpha1/kgateway/zz_generated.deepcopy.go), [gateway.kgateway.dev_trafficpolicies.yaml](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-9dx3n06x/install/helm/kgateway-crds/templates/gateway.kgateway.dev_trafficpolicies.yaml)):
   - Added `ConsistentHash` to [`TrafficPolicySpec`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-9dx3n06x/api/v1alpha1/kgateway/traffic_policy_types.go#L47-L157) along with [`ConsistentHash`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-9dx3n06x/api/v1alpha1/kgateway/traffic_policy_types.go#L618-L642), [`HeaderHashPolicy`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-9dx3n06x/api/v1alpha1/kgateway/traffic_policy_types.go#L645-L658), [`HeaderRegexRewrite`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-9dx3n06x/api/v1alpha1/kgateway/traffic_policy_types.go#L661-L670), [`CookieHashPolicy`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-9dx3n06x/api/v1alpha1/kgateway/traffic_policy_types.go#L673-L694), [`CookieAttribute`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-9dx3n06x/api/v1alpha1/kgateway/traffic_policy_types.go#L697-L706), [`QueryParameterHashPolicy`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-9dx3n06x/api/v1alpha1/kgateway/traffic_policy_types.go#L709-L718), [`FilterStateHashPolicy`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-9dx3n06x/api/v1alpha1/kgateway/traffic_policy_types.go#L721-L730), and [`SourceIPHashPolicy`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-9dx3n06x/api/v1alpha1/kgateway/traffic_policy_types.go#L733-L737).
   - Regenerated deepcopy methods and the `TrafficPolicy` CRD schema.

2. **IR Construction, Validation, Merging & Route Translation** ([consistent_hash.go](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-9dx3n06x/pkg/kgateway/extensions2/plugins/trafficpolicy/consistent_hash.go), [traffic_policy_plugin.go](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-9dx3n06x/pkg/kgateway/extensions2/plugins/trafficpolicy/traffic_policy_plugin.go), [constructor.go](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-9dx3n06x/pkg/kgateway/extensions2/plugins/trafficpolicy/constructor.go), [merge.go](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-9dx3n06x/pkg/kgateway/extensions2/plugins/trafficpolicy/merge.go)):
   - Implemented [`constructConsistentHash`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-9dx3n06x/pkg/kgateway/extensions2/plugins/trafficpolicy/consistent_hash.go#L78-L227) to build Envoy `RouteAction_HashPolicy` entries in canonical type order (`headers`, `cookies`, `queryParameters`, `filterState`, `sourceIp`), deduplicate entries by key (case-insensitively for `headers`, preserving first casing), support header `regexRewrite`, parse cookie `ttl` as Go duration or integer seconds, pass cookie `attributes` through, and default empty `{}` to a single `sourceIp` hash policy (`terminal: false`).
   - Handled `disable: true` validation and suppression of broader-scoped hash policies.
   - Implemented [`mergeConsistentHash`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-9dx3n06x/pkg/kgateway/extensions2/plugins/trafficpolicy/merge.go#L625-L673) and [`unionConsistentHashIR`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-9dx3n06x/pkg/kgateway/extensions2/plugins/trafficpolicy/consistent_hash.go#L248-L314) to union array fields with higher-priority entries first, deduplicate by key, re-sort into canonical type order, retain the higher-priority policy's `sourceIp` scalar value even when unset, and record merge metadata under `consistentHash`.
   - Applied hash policies to `RouteAction` via [`applyConsistentHash`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-9dx3n06x/pkg/kgateway/extensions2/plugins/trafficpolicy/consistent_hash.go#L317-L328).

3. **Tests** ([consistent_hash_test.go](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-9dx3n06x/pkg/kgateway/extensions2/plugins/trafficpolicy/consistent_hash_test.go), [gateway_translator_test.go](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-9dx3n06x/pkg/kgateway/translator/gateway/gateway_translator_test.go), [consistent-hash.yaml](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-9dx3n06x/pkg/kgateway/translator/gateway/testutils/inputs/traffic-policy/consistent-hash.yaml)):
   - Added unit tests for IR equality, validation, construction, deduplication, TTL parsing, and policy merging.
   - Added end-to-end gateway translator tests verifying Envoy `hashPolicy` output, `disable` suppression, multi-policy merging, and `merge.TrafficPolicy.gateway.kgateway.dev` metadata.
